planning_horizon_H: <int> Total number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
num_orders_n: <int> Number of orders to be scheduled.
unit_cost_nonregular_capacity_sigma: <float> Cost per unit of nonregular (overtime) capacity used in any period.
capacities: <list[int], length H> Regular workforce capacity in man-hours available in each period.

orders.work_content_p: <int> Total man-hours of work required to complete the order.
orders.lower_exec_interval_length_l: <int> Minimum number of consecutive periods over which the order must be executed.
orders.upper_exec_interval_length_l_bar: <int> Maximum number of consecutive periods over which the order may be executed.
orders.intensity_upper_bound_UB: <float> Maximum fraction of the order's work content that may be performed in any single period.
orders.intensity_lower_bound_LB: <float> Minimum fraction of the order's work content that must be performed in any period during which the order is active.
orders.release_date_r: <int> Earliest period in which work on the order may begin.
orders.due_date_d: <int> Target completion period after which tardiness penalties apply.
orders.tardiness_cost_w: <int> Per-period penalty cost incurred for each period the order finishes past its due date.
